title: Which Shell?
lines: Ted and Phil look at ten shells.
"Which shell do you want?" said Phil.
Ted picks a thin red shell in wet mud.
Ted digs and digs. It will not pop up.
"When we get a dish, it will," said Phil.
Phil ran back and got a red dish.
Ted digs with the dish, and the shell pops.
"I got it!" said Ted. Phil hops up.
Then Phil digs with the dish and gets a shell as well.
Ted and Phil sit with the shells in the sun.

questions.ask: Where was the thin red shell that Ted picked?
questions.listenFor: In wet mud. Line three says it. If they guess, send them back to that line.

questions.ask: Digging with his hands did not work. What did Phil get so it would?
questions.listenFor: A red dish. Lines five and six say it. Two children, one job.

questions.ask: Which of the two shells would you have picked? What made you pick it?
questions.listenFor: Either. Ted's is the thin red one in line three; Phil's is the one he digs up in line nine. The reason is the part worth praising.
